szoveg_eredeti:
Dustin Myers is coming to ElevenLabs Summit NYC.

Dustin is EVP of Production Operations + Technology at FOX Sports , where he leads the production operations, engineering, and technology behind the network’s biggest live events from the Super Bowl to FIFA World Cup. A multiple Sports Emmy Award winner, he pairs a storyteller’s instincts with deep technical expertise, and he adopts AI where it enhances the broadcast while protecting the craft that defines it.

On November 11, Dustin will join Alex George , Localization Lead at ElevenLabs, for an ElevenProductions conversation on what it takes to bring AI into live sports production.
